scientific_integrity: Exact positive primitive two-cycle existence and uniqueness from a strictly decreasing hyperbolic-sine ratio; exact p=2 local hyperbolic stability from a quadratic multiplier. The earlier paper supplied a sufficient existence direction; finite computations are supplementary, not a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a scalar positive map, not arbitrary periods or the full economic model; p=2 is the only exponent with an explicit stability classification. No nonlinear conclusion at multiplier -1 or the merger at a=1/3.
scientific_review: Three-axis mathematical assessment passed, subject to documented historical-priority risks; no external expert or Lean verification is claimed.
title: A unique inverse-power two-cycle and its sharp stability boundary
